description:
FILED AND FIXED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25), from the Log-Log4perl-1.58 board census (t/024WarnDieCarp.t "croak without stringify" / "confess without stringify": `$logger->logcroak({ foo => "bar" })` then `$@->{foo}`).  PRE-EXISTING (main 31cd8c02).

    use Carp; eval { croak { foo => "bar" } }; print ref($@), " ", (ref $@ ? $@->{foo} : $@), "\n";
  perl 5.40.3: HASH bar      PCL: " HASH(0x1)"   (probe scratch/s526w2/pcroak.pl)

perl's Carp (longmess_heavy / ret_summary): "don't break references as exceptions" -- a reference first argument is returned / died with untouched.

=== DONE (s526w2) ===
lib/Carp.pm (the module's own layer, CLAUDE.md 9a): longmess / shortmess return the reference (wantarray ? @_ : $_[0]) when $_[0] is a ref; croak / confess `die @_`; carp / cluck `warn @_`.  A plain string is unchanged.  Guard Pl/t/misc-fixes-01.t row 144 (inverse-verified on a 31cd8c02 extraction).
subject: lib/Carp.pm shim stringified a REFERENCE exception: `croak { foo => "bar" }` / `confess [...]` died with "HASH(0x1)\n" where Carp passes the reference through (Log::Log4perl logcroak / logconfess)
